summary: Scalar-deleting destructor idiom: resets the object vtable pointer to the type vtable off_5A5E40, runs ObjectInitWithVTableCleanup (0048D3E0) for teardown, then, when the deletion flag a2 bit 0 is set, frees the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf (00587BCF). Returns the object pointer. Owner object type is not identified by the packet.

local_names.a2: MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor flag; bit 0 requests memory free
local_names.off_5A5E40: type vtable pointer restored during destruction
local_names.ObjectInitWithVTableCleanup: teardown routine invoked on the object
local_names.FreeWrapper_7bcf: memory free wrapper invoked for the object block

operations.description: Reset the vtable pointer: store the address of off_5A5E40 into the object's first field (vtable slot at offset 0)
Call ObjectInitWithVTableCleanup (0048D3E0) with this to perform object teardown/cleanup
Test deletion flag: if (a2 & 1) != 0 the object memory is freed; otherwise the destructor returns without freeing
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf (00587BCF) with this to free the object memory block when a2 bit 0 is set

unresolved: The object type owning this destructor is not identified; off_5A5E40 is a vtable data address only
The a2 deletion flag follows the MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention but the producer call sites are not in the packet, so that role is inference, not packet evidence
